pairs: let all the inhabitants of the land be stirred up.
For the day of the Lord is on its way;
a day of darkness and gloom,
a day of clouds and whirlwinds.
quasi mane expansum super montes populus multus et fortis:
Like the morning reaching over the mountains, they are a numerous and strong people.
similis ei non fuit a principio,
Nothing like them has existed since the beginning,
et post eum non erit usque in annos generationis et generationis.
nor will exist after them, even in the years of generation upon generation.
Before their face is a devouring fire,
and behind them is a burning flame.
Quasi hortus voluptatis terra coram eo,
The land before them is like a lush garden,
and behind them is a desolate desert,
and there is no one who can escape them.
Their appearance is like the appearance of horses,
and they will rush forward like horsemen.
Sicut sonitus quadrigarum super capita montium exilient,
Like the sound of a four-horse chariot, they will leap over the tops of the mountains.
sicut sonitus flammæ ignis devorantis stipulam,
Like the sound of a burning flame devouring stubble,
velut populus fortis præparatus ad prælium.
they are as a strong people prepared for battle.
Before their face, the people will be tortured;
each one’s appearance will retreat, as if into a jar.
They will rush forward, as if they were strong.
Like valiant warriors, they will ascend the wall.
The men will advance, each one on his own way,
et non declinabunt a semitis suis.
and they will not turn aside from their path.
And each one will not hem in his brother;
every one will walk in his own rough path.
they will drop through the breach and not be harmed.
They will advance into the city;
they will rush through the wall.
they will go in through the windows, like a thief.
The sun and moon have been obscured,
and the stars have retracted their splendor.
Et Dominus dedit vocem suam ante faciem exercitus sui,
And the Lord has bestowed his voice before the face of his army.
quia multa sunt nimis castra ejus,
For its military camps are very numerous;
quia fortia et facientia verbum ejus:
for they are strong and they carry out his word.
magnus enim dies Domini, et terribilis valde,
For the day of the Lord is great and so very terrible,
convertimini ad me in toto corde vestro,
“Be converted to me with your whole heart,
in jejunio, et in fletu, et in planctu.
in fasting and weeping and mourning.”
et convertimini ad Dominum Deum vestrum,
and convert to the Lord your God.
For he is gracious and merciful,
Quis scit si convertatur, et ignoscat,
Who knows if he might convert and forgive,
and bequeath a blessing after him,
sacrificium et libamen Domino Deo vestro?
a sacrifice and a libation to the Lord your God?
Let the bridegroom depart from his bed,
and the bride from her bridal chamber.
Inter vestibulum et altare plorabunt sacerdotes,
Between the vestibule and the altar, the priests, the ministers of the Lord,
will weep, and they will say:
et ne des hæreditatem tuam in opprobrium,
And do not bequeath your inheritance into disgrace,
so that the nations would rule over them.
Why should they say among the peoples,
The Lord has been zealous for his land,
and he has spared his people.
and he said to his people:
Ecce ego mittam vobis frumentum, et vinum,
“Behold, I will send you grain and wine and oil,
and you will again be filled with them.
et non dabo vos ultra opprobrium in gentibus.
And I will no longer give you disgrace among the Gentiles.
Et eum qui ab aquilone est procul faciam a vobis,
And he who is from the North, I will drive far from you.
et expellam eum in terram inviam et desertam:
And I will expel him into an impassable land, and into the desert,
with his face opposite the Eastern sea,
et extremum ejus ad mare novissimum:
and his furthest part towards the furthest sea.
For the Lord has great esteem for what he has done.
For the beauty of the wilderness has sprung forth.
For the tree has borne its fruit.
ficus et vinea dederunt virtutem suam.
The fig tree and the vine have bestowed their virtue.
et lætamini in Domino Deo vestro,
exult and rejoice in the Lord your God.
For he has given you a teacher of justice,
et descendere faciet ad vos imbrem matutinum et serotinum, sicut in principio.
and he will make the early and the late rains descend to you, just as it was in the beginning.
And the threshing floors will be filled with grain,
et redundabunt torcularia vino et oleo.
and the presses will overflow with wine and oil.
Et reddam vobis annos, quos comedit locusta,
And I will repay you for the years which the locust,
et eruca: fortitudo mea magna quam misi in vos.
and the caterpillar consumed: my great strength which I sent upon you.
And you will eat with enjoyment,
et laudabitis nomen Domini Dei vestri,
and you will praise the name of the Lord your God,
who has worked miracles with you,
et non confundetur populus meus in sempiternum.
and my people will not be confounded forever.
Et scietis quia in medio Israël ego sum,
And you will know that I am in the midst of Israel,
and I am the Lord your God,
et non confundetur populus meus in æternum.
and my people will not be confounded forever.
effundam spiritum meum super omnem carnem,
it will happen that I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh,
et prophetabunt filii vestri et filiæ vestræ:
and your sons and your daughters will prophesy;
and your youths will see visions.
Sed et super servos meos et ancillas in diebus illis effundam spiritum meum.
Moreover, in those days I will pour out my spirit upon my servants and handmaids.
Et dabo prodigia in cælo et in terra,
And I will grant wonders in the sky and on earth:
sanguinem, et ignem, et vaporem fumi.
blood and fire and the vapor of smoke.
The sun will be turned into darkness,
antequam veniat dies Domini magnus et horribilis.
before the great and terrible day of the Lord shall arrive.
And it will happen that everyone who will call upon the name of the Lord will be saved.
quia in monte Sion et in Jerusalem erit salvatio,
and in the remnant whom the Lord will call,
et in residuis quos Dominus vocaverit.
just as the Lord has said.
